source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥דיְהוָ֤ה׀שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of David. YHWH, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplications; in your faithfulness answer me, in your righteousness.

en.L: A psalm of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear my prayer; give ear to my pleas for mercy; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness answer me, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.B: A psalm of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear my prayer; listen as I plead for mercy. Answer me in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.R: A song of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear my prayer. Listen when I beg {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help. Answer me, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do what is right.

fr.L: Psaume de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière ; prête l’oreille à mes supplications ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité réponds-moi, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.B: Un psaume de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière ; entends-moi quand je demande grâce. Réponds-moi dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité et dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.R: Un chant de David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière. Entends-moi quand je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} supplie de m’aider. Réponds-moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Daudi. \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie maombi yangu; utege sikio kwa kusihi kwangu; \q kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unijibu, \q kwa haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Daudi. \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie maombi yangu; usikilize ninapokusihi unihurumie. \q Unijibu kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kwa haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie maombi yangu. Unisikilize ninapokuomba msaada. \q Unijibu, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu na unatenda yaliyo haki.

es.L: Salmo de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, oye mi oración; escucha mis súplicas; por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad respóndeme, por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.B: Salmo de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, oye mi oración; escucha mientras te ruego compasión. Respóndeme por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad y por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.R: Canto de David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, oye mi oración. Escúchame cuando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego que me ayudes. Respóndeme, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces lo correcto.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe lời cầu nguyện của tôi; xin lắng tai nghe lời nài xin thương xót của tôi; \q xin đáp lời tôi trong sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q trong sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thi thiên của Đa-vít. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe lời tôi cầu nguyện; xin lắng nghe khi tôi nài xin thương xót. \q Xin đáp lời tôi theo sự thành tín và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe lời tôi cầu nguyện. Xin lắng nghe khi tôi nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ. \q Xin trả lời tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng thành tín và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều công chính.

ko.L: 다윗의 시. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 기도를 들어 주십시오. 자비를 구하는 제 간구에 귀를 기울여 주십시오. \q 주님의 신실하심으로 제게 응답하여 주십시오, \q 주님의 의로.
ko.B: 다윗의 시. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 기도를 들어 주십시오. 자비를 구하는 제 간구를 들어 주십시오. \q 주님의 신실하심과 주님의 의로 제게 응답하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 기도를 들어 주십시오. 제가 도와 달라고 애원할 때 들어 주십시오. \q 주님은 신실하시고 옳은 일을 하시는 분이시니, 제게 대답해 주십시오.

pt.L: Salmo de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ouve a minha oração; dá ouvidos às minhas súplicas; na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade responde-me, na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.B: Salmo de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ouve a minha oração; escuta quando suplico por misericórdia. Responde-me na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade e na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.R: Canção de Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ouve a minha oração. Escuta quando eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço socorro. Responde-me, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és fiel e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes o que é certo.

am.L: የዳዊት መዝሙር። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ \q ልመናዬን አድምጥ፤ \q በታማኝነትህ መልስልኝ፣ በጽድቅህ።
am.B: የዳዊት መዝሙር። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ ምሕረትህን ስለምን አድምጠኝ። \q በታማኝነትህና በጽድቅህ መልስልኝ።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጸሎቴን ስማ። እንድትረዳኝ ስለምንህ አድምጠኝ። \q አንተ ታማኝ ነህ፤ ትክክል የሆነውንም ታደርጋለህ፤ ስለዚህ መልስልኝ።

hi.L: दाऊद का भजन। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी प्रार्थना सुन; दया के लिए मेरी विनतियों पर कान लगा; अपनी सच्चाई में मुझे उत्तर दे, अपनी धार्मिकता में।
hi.B: दाऊद का भजन। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी प्रार्थना सुन; जब मैं दया के लिए गिड़गिड़ाता हूँ, तो कान लगा। अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता और अपनी धार्मिकता के कारण मुझे उत्तर दे।
hi.R: दाऊद का गीत। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी प्रार्थना सुन। जब मैं तुझसे सहायता की भीख माँगता हूँ, तो मेरी सुन। मुझे उत्तर दे, क्योंकि तू विश्वासयोग्य है और तू वही करता है जो सही है।

ru.L: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, услышь мою молитву; внемли моим мольбам о милости; по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} верности ответь мне, по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности.
ru.B: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, услышь мою молитву; выслушай, как я молю о милости. Ответь мне по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} верности и по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности.
ru.R: Песнь Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, услышь мою молитву. Выслушай, когда я умоляю {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} о помощи. Ответь мне, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поступаешь справедливо.

ja.L: ダビデの賛歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの祈りを聞いてください。わたしの嘆願に耳を傾けてください。あなたの真実によって、わたしに答えてください、あなたの義によって。
ja.B: ダビデの賛歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの祈りを聞き、恵みを求めるわたしの願いに耳を傾けてください。あなたの真実と、あなたの義によって、わたしに答えてください。
ja.R: ダビデの歌。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの祈りを聞いてください。わたしが助けを求めるとき、耳を傾けてください。あなたは真実な方、正しいことをなさる方だから、わたしに答えてください。

uk.L: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, почуй мою молитву; прихили вухо до моїх благань про милість; у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} вірності відповідай мені, у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} праведності.
uk.B: Псалом Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, почуй мою молитву; вислухай, як я благаю про милість. Відповідай мені у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} вірності й у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} праведності.
uk.R: Пісня Давида. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, почуй мою молитву. Вислухай, коли я благаю {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} про допомогу. Відповідай мені, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вірний і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чиниш правильно.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 141:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1.

decisions.choice: your faithfulness, your righteousness: God's own character
decisions.reason: The psalmist appeals to what God is: faithful to his promises ('emunah) and righteous (tsedaqah), the one who sets things right for those who trust him (31:2; 71:2). He does not appeal to his own righteousness (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the last of the seven penitential psalms
decisions.reason: From early times the church has read Psalms 6, 32, 38, 51, 102, 130 and 143 as psalms of repentance.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: because you are faithful and you do what is right
alternatives: in your faithfulness, in your righteousness
decisions.reason: Readable turns the nouns into plain statements about God (m2).

decisions.choice: "신실하심" and "의" for God's faithfulness and righteousness
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the style guide (의 for righteousness); Readable turns the nouns into what God is and does, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 143.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalm speaks to God with तू.

decisions.choice: सच्चाई (L), विश्वासयोग्यता (B, R); धार्मिकता
decisions.reason: God's 'emunah is सच्चाई at Literal and विश्वासयोग्यता at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry note settles; his righteousness is धार्मिकता.

decisions.choice: Псалом Давида (L, B); Песнь Давида (R)
decisions.reason: The title (m1) follows the Psalms terms note, as in the earlier psalms.

decisions.choice: 'emunah "真実" (L, B), tsedaqah "義" (L, B); R "真実な方、正しいことをなさる方" as the English R
decisions.reason: Psalter key words (PSA-1); God's own character (m2). "なさる" avoids the passive-looking "行われる".

source.text: וְאַל־תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כָל־חָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And do not enter into judgment with your servant, for not is righteous before you any living.

en.L: And do not enter into judgment with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, for no one living is righteous before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Do not bring {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant to trial, for no living person can be found in the right before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Please do not take me to court and judge me. I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. No one alive is innocent in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes.

fr.L: Et n’entre pas en jugement avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, car aucun vivant n’est juste devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Ne fais pas passer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur en jugement, car aucun être vivant ne peut être trouvé juste devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Ne me traîne pas au tribunal pour me juger. Je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Personne en vie n’est innocent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux.

sw.L: Wala usiingie katika hukumu na mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kwa maana hakuna aliye hai aliye mwenye haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Usimpeleke mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hukumuni, \q kwa maana hakuna mtu aliye hai anayeweza kuonekana mwenye haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Tafadhali usinipeleke mahakamani na kunihukumu. \q Mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Hakuna mtu aliye hai asiye na hatia machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}.

es.L: Y no entres en juicio con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, porque no es justo delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} ningún viviente.
es.B: No lleves a juicio a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, porque ningún ser viviente puede ser hallado justo delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Por favor, no me lleves a juicio para juzgarme. Soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. Nadie que viva es inocente ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos.

vi.L: Và xin đừng vào cuộc xét xử với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng có người sống nào là công chính.
vi.B: Xin đừng đem đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra xét xử, \q vì trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không một người sống nào được kể là công chính.
vi.R: Xin đừng đem tôi ra tòa mà xét xử. Tôi là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không một người nào còn sống là vô tội.

ko.L: 주님의 종을 심판하러 들어가지 마십시오. \q 살아 있는 사람은 아무도 주님 앞에서 의롭지 못하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님의 종을 재판에 부치지 마십시오. \q 살아 있는 사람 가운데 주님 앞에서 의롭다 인정받을 사람은 아무도 없습니다.
ko.R: 제발 저를 법정에 세워 심판하지 마십시오. 저는 주님의 종입니다. \q 살아 있는 사람 가운데 주님 보시기에 죄 없는 사람은 아무도 없습니다.

pt.L: E não entres em juízo com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, pois nenhum vivente é justo diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Não leves o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo a julgamento, pois nenhum ser vivo pode ser declarado justo diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Por favor, não me leves ao tribunal para me julgar. Eu sou o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo. Ninguém que vive é inocente aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos.

am.L: ከባሪያህም ጋር ወደ ፍርድ አትግባ፤ \q በፊትህ ሕያው ሁሉ አይጸድቅምና።
am.B: አገልጋይህን ወደ ፍርድ አታቅርብ፤ \q በፊትህ የሚጸድቅ ሕያው ማንም የለምና።
am.R: እባክህ ወደ ፍርድ አቅርበህ አትፍረድብኝ። እኔ አገልጋይህ ነኝ። \q በአንተ ፊት ንጹሕ የሆነ አንድም ሕያው ሰው የለም።

hi.L: और अपने दास के साथ न्याय में न पड़, क्योंकि कोई भी जीवित प्राणी तेरे सामने धर्मी नहीं [ठहरता]।
hi.B: अपने दास पर मुक़दमा न चला, क्योंकि कोई भी जीवित मनुष्य तेरे सामने धर्मी नहीं ठहर सकता।
hi.R: कृपया मुझे अदालत में ले जाकर मेरा न्याय न कर। मैं तेरा दास हूँ। कोई भी जीवित मनुष्य तेरी दृष्टि में निर्दोष नहीं ठहर सकता।

ru.L: И не входи в суд с {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} рабом, потому что не оправдается перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} никто из живущих.
ru.B: Не призывай {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} раба на суд, потому что ни один живой человек не будет оправдан перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.
ru.R: Пожалуйста, не веди меня в суд и не суди меня. Я {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} раб. Никто из живых не может быть оправдан перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.

ja.L: あなたのしもべと共に、裁きの場に入らないでください。あなたの前に正しい者は、生きている者の中にひとりもいないからである。
ja.B: あなたのしもべを裁きの座に連れ出さないでください。生きている者はだれひとり、あなたの前に正しいとされないからである。
ja.R: どうか、わたしを裁判にかけて裁かないでください。わたしはあなたのしもべだ。生きている人で、あなたの目に罪のない人は、ひとりもいない。

uk.L: І не входь у суд з {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} рабом, бо ніхто з живих не праведний перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.
uk.B: Не віддавай {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} раба під суд, бо жодна жива людина не виявиться правою перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.
uk.R: Будь ласка, не тягни мене на суд і не суди мене. Я — {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} раб. Ніхто з живих не безвинний в {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} очах.

decisions.choice: Romans 3:20; Galatians 2:16
decisions.reason: Paul echoes this line when he says that no one will be declared righteous before God by doing what the law requires (Romans 3:20; Galatians 2:16).

decisions.choice: enter into judgment: take to court
decisions.reason: The picture is of a lawsuit, with God as the one who brings the case (Job 9:32; 22:4; Isaiah 3:14).

decisions.choice: be righteous: be in the right, be found innocent
decisions.reason: The verb (tsadaq) is the language of the court: to be in the right, to win the case (51:6; Job 9:2).

decisions.choice: innocent
decisions.reason: Readable gives the court sense of the word (m3).

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level for the psalmist's name for himself
decisions.reason: Elsewhere ʿeved is "esclave" at Literal. Where the psalmist calls himself God's servant, French settled "serviteur" at every level: it is a humble self-description in prayer, not a statement about slavery.

decisions.choice: siervo at every level for "your servant"
decisions.reason: When the psalmist calls himself God's servant ('eved), Spanish says "siervo" at every level, Literal included, as for God's servants throughout the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ngài" at every level for the psalmist calling himself God's servant
decisions.reason: "Your servant" is how a worshiper speaks of himself to God; "đầy tớ" is the humble word Vietnamese uses for it, and "nô lệ" would make it a statement about slavery.

decisions.choice: "주님의 종" at every level for "your servant"
decisions.reason: The psalmist names himself by his relation to God (meaning decision); the Psalms-wide wording is "주님의 종", with "종" as the style guide's word for servant.

decisions.choice: nenhum vivente é justo diante de ti (L); nenhum ser vivo pode ser declarado justo diante de ti (B)
alternatives: nenhum vivente será justificado diante de ti
decisions.reason: Paul echoes this line in Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16 (m1). Balanced keeps their Portuguese, "declarado justo diante dele", "nenhum ser humano será declarado justo", which also says the court sense of the verb (m3). Literal keeps the Hebrew, an active "is righteous", rather than Paul's passive "será justificada"; Readable says "inocente", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "አይጸድቅም" (is not righteous, is not found in the right)
decisions.reason: The line is echoed in Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16 (meaning decision m1), not quoted word for word; the verb of the court, "be in the right" (m3), is the "ጸደቀ" the Amharic of those verses uses, so a reader can hear the echo.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያህ" (L), "አገልጋይህ" (B, R) for "your servant"
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets for "your servant" in prayer.

decisions.choice: कोई भी ... तेरे सामने धर्मी नहीं ठहरता (L, B)
decisions.reason: Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16 echo this line, and Hindi keeps their verb, धर्मी ठहरना, where the Hebrew says the same. The Hebrew says "no one living" where Paul says "no flesh", and it has nothing of "works of the law", so those words are not carried over. Readable says निर्दोष for the court sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: दास
decisions.reason: The psalmist's "your servant" is दास at every level, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: не оправдается перед тобой (L); не будет оправдан перед тобой (B); не может быть оправдан перед тобой (R)
decisions.reason: Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16 echo this line (m1), so each level takes the verb of Romans 3:20 in this translation; it carries the court sense of being found in the right (m3). The Hebrew says "no one living" where Paul says "no flesh", so the subject stays the psalm's.

decisions.choice: раб
decisions.reason: The psalmist's "your servant" is "раб" at every level, as settled for the Psalms.

decisions.choice: lo'-yitsdaq lefanekha khol-chai "あなたの前に正しい者は…ひとりもいない" (L), "…正しいとされない" (B), "罪のない人は、ひとりもいない" (R)
decisions.reason: The line stands behind Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16 (m1), but the Hebrew says 'be in the right' (m3), not the letters' 'be justified by works of law'; the Japanese follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 'avdekha "あなたのしもべ" at every level
decisions.reason: Psalter rule (PSA-1): the psalmist's 'your servant' is しもべ.

source.text: כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑י הוֹשִׁיבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For he has pursued, [the] enemy, my soul; he has crushed to the ground my life; he has made me dwell in dark places like [the] dead of long ago.

en.L: For [the] enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the ground; he has made me dwell in dark places like the dead of long ago.
en.B: The enemy has hunted me down and ground my life into the dust; he has left me to live in dark places, like people dead for ages.
en.R: My enemy has chased me and beaten me down to the ground. He makes me live in darkness, as if I had died long ago.

fr.L: Car [l’]ennemi a poursuivi mon âme ; il a écrasé ma vie contre terre ; il m’a fait habiter dans des lieux obscurs comme les morts d’autrefois.
fr.B: L’ennemi m’a pourchassé et a broyé ma vie dans la poussière ; il m’a fait vivre dans les ténèbres, comme ceux qui sont morts depuis longtemps.
fr.R: Mon ennemi m’a poursuivi et m’a jeté par terre. Il me fait vivre dans le noir, comme si j’étais mort il y a longtemps.

sw.L: Kwa maana adui ameifuatia nafsi yangu; \q ameuponda uhai wangu hata chini; \q amenikalisha mahali pa giza kama wafu wa zamani.
sw.B: Adui amenisaka na kuyasaga maisha yangu mavumbini; \q ameniacha niishi mahali pa giza, \q kama watu waliokufa zamani sana.
sw.R: Adui yangu amenifukuza na kunipiga hadi chini. \q Ananifanya niishi gizani, kana kwamba nilikufa zamani.

es.L: Porque [el] enemigo ha perseguido mi alma; ha aplastado mi vida contra el suelo; me ha hecho habitar en lugares oscuros como los muertos de hace mucho.
es.B: El enemigo me ha perseguido hasta alcanzarme y ha molido mi vida en el polvo; me ha dejado vivir en lugares oscuros, como gente muerta hace siglos.
es.R: Mi enemigo me ha perseguido y me ha tirado al suelo. Me hace vivir en la oscuridad, como si hubiera muerto hace mucho tiempo.

vi.L: Vì kẻ thù đã đuổi theo linh hồn tôi; \q nó đã chà đạp mạng sống tôi xuống đất; \q nó đã bắt tôi ở trong những nơi tối tăm như những người chết từ xưa.
vi.B: Kẻ thù đã săn đuổi tôi và nghiền nát mạng sống tôi xuống bụi đất; \q nó bắt tôi phải sống trong nơi tối tăm \q như những người đã chết từ lâu đời.
vi.R: Kẻ thù đã đuổi theo tôi và đánh tôi ngã gục xuống đất. \q Nó bắt tôi sống trong bóng tối, như thể tôi đã chết từ lâu rồi.

ko.L: 참으로 원수가 제 영혼을 뒤쫓았고, \q 제 생명을 땅에 짓밟았으며, \q 오래전에 죽은 사람들처럼 저를 어두운 곳에 살게 하였습니다.
ko.B: 원수가 저를 사냥하듯 쫓아와 제 목숨을 땅바닥에 짓이겼습니다. \q 그는 오래전에 죽은 사람들처럼 \q 저를 어두운 곳에 살게 했습니다.
ko.R: 제 원수가 저를 쫓아와 땅바닥에 쓰러뜨렸습니다. \q 그는 제가 오래전에 죽은 사람인 것처럼 저를 어둠 속에서 살게 합니다.

pt.L: Pois [o] inimigo perseguiu a minha alma; esmagou a minha vida contra o chão; fez-me habitar em lugares escuros como os mortos de há muito tempo.
pt.B: O inimigo me caçou e reduziu a minha vida a pó; deixou-me morando em lugares escuros, como gente morta há séculos.
pt.R: O meu inimigo me perseguiu e me derrubou no chão. Ele me faz viver na escuridão, como se eu tivesse morrido há muito tempo.

am.L: ጠላት ነፍሴን አሳዷልና፤ \q ሕይወቴን ወደ ምድር ቀጥቅጧል፤ \q ከጥንት እንደ ሞቱት በጨለማ ስፍራዎች አኖረኝ።
am.B: ጠላት አሳድዶ ያዘኝ፤ ሕይወቴንም ደቁሶ ከአፈር ጋር ደባለቀው፤ \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት እንደ ሞቱ ሰዎች በጨለማ ስፍራ \q እንድኖር አደረገኝ።
am.R: ጠላቴ አሳደደኝ፤ ደብድቦም መሬት ላይ ጣለኝ። \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት የሞትኩ ይመስል በጨለማ ውስጥ እንድኖር ያደርገኛል።

hi.L: क्योंकि शत्रु ने मेरे प्राण का पीछा किया है; उसने मेरे जीवन को भूमि पर कुचल डाला है; उसने मुझे अंधेरे स्थानों में बसाया है, बहुत पहले के मरे हुओं के समान।
hi.B: शत्रु ने मेरा पीछा करके मुझे पकड़ लिया है और मेरे जीवन को धूल में रौंद डाला है; उसने मुझे अंधेरे स्थानों में रहने को छोड़ दिया है, उन लोगों के समान जो युगों पहले मर चुके हैं।
hi.R: मेरे शत्रु ने मेरा पीछा किया है और मुझे मारकर भूमि पर गिरा दिया है। वह मुझे अंधकार में रहने पर विवश करता है, मानो मैं बहुत पहले मर चुका हूँ।

ru.L: Ведь враг преследовал мою душу; он растоптал мою жизнь до земли; он поселил меня во тьме, как давно умерших.
ru.B: Враг выследил меня и втоптал мою жизнь в прах; он оставил меня жить в тёмных местах, как людей, умерших много веков назад.
ru.R: Мой враг гнался за мной и сбил меня на землю. Он заставляет меня жить во тьме, как будто я давно умер.

ja.L: まことに、敵はわたしの魂を追い、わたしの命を地に打ち砕き、とこしえの死者のように、わたしを暗い所に住まわせた。
ja.B: 敵はわたしを追い詰め、わたしの命を地に踏みにじり、とうの昔に死んだ人々のように、わたしを暗い所に住まわせた。
ja.R: 敵はわたしを追いかけ、地面に打ち倒した。そして、わたしを暗やみの中に住まわせる。まるで、ずっと昔に死んだ人のように。

uk.L: Бо ворог переслідував мою душу; він розчавив до землі моє життя; він оселив мене в темних місцях, як давно померлих.
uk.B: Ворог вистежив мене й утоптав моє життя в порох; він залишив мене жити в темних місцях, як людей, що давно померли.
uk.R: Мій ворог гнався за мною і збив мене на землю. Він змушує мене жити в темряві, ніби я помер давно.

decisions.choice: like the dead of long ago: Lamentations 3:6
decisions.reason: Lamentations 3:6 uses the same words: "he has made me dwell in dark places like the dead of long ago".

decisions.choice: dark places: the darkness of the grave, or a dark hiding place
decisions.reason: Darkness is the place of the dead (88:7, 13). The psalmist feels as good as buried.

decisions.choice: the enemy: one enemy, or enemies as a group
decisions.reason: The enemy is singular, but verses 9 and 12 speak of enemies in the plural.

decisions.choice: bemachashakkim kemetei 'olam "とこしえの死者のように…暗い所に" (L), "とうの昔に死んだ人々のように" (B), "ずっと昔に死んだ人のように" (R)
decisions.reason: As Lamentations 3:6 (m1); the dark places are left as the grave or a hiding place (m2). L moves the simile before the verb, as Japanese word order needs.

source.text: וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י רוּחִ֑י בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it faints upon me, my spirit; in my midst is appalled my heart.

en.L: So my spirit grows faint within me; in my midst my heart is appalled.
en.B: My spirit sinks within me, and my heart is stunned inside me.
en.R: I feel weak and ready to give up. Deep inside I am in shock.

fr.L: Et mon esprit défaille en moi ; au milieu de moi mon cœur est consterné.
fr.B: Mon esprit s’effondre en moi, et mon cœur est frappé de stupeur au-dedans de moi.
fr.R: Je me sens faible et prêt à abandonner. Au fond de moi, je suis sous le choc.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo roho yangu inazimia ndani yangu; \q ndani yangu moyo wangu umeshtuka.
sw.B: Roho yangu inazama ndani yangu, \q na moyo wangu umepigwa na bumbuazi ndani yangu.
sw.R: Ninajiona dhaifu na tayari kukata tamaa. \q Ndani yangu nimeshtuka sana.

es.L: Por eso mi espíritu desfallece dentro de mí; en medio de mí mi corazón está aterrado.
es.B: Mi espíritu se hunde dentro de mí, y mi corazón está aturdido en mi interior.
es.R: Me siento débil y a punto de rendirme. En lo más profundo estoy en estado de shock.

vi.L: Vì vậy tâm linh tôi mòn mỏi trong tôi; \q lòng tôi kinh hoàng trong tôi.
vi.B: Tâm linh tôi rã rời trong tôi, \q và lòng tôi bàng hoàng sững sờ.
vi.R: Tôi thấy mình yếu đuối và muốn buông xuôi. \q Sâu trong lòng, tôi bàng hoàng sợ hãi.

ko.L: 그래서 제 영이 제 안에서 약해지고, \q 제 속에서 제 마음이 놀라 떨고 있습니다.
ko.B: 제 영이 속에서 가라앉고, \q 제 마음이 안에서 얼어붙었습니다.
ko.R: 저는 힘이 다 빠져서 포기하고 싶습니다. \q 속으로는 너무 놀라 어찌할 바를 모르겠습니다.

pt.L: Por isso o meu espírito desfalece dentro de mim; no meu íntimo o meu coração está atônito.
pt.B: O meu espírito afunda dentro de mim, e o meu coração está atordoado no meu peito.
pt.R: Eu me sinto fraco e a ponto de desistir. Lá dentro de mim, estou em choque.

am.L: ስለዚህ መንፈሴ በውስጤ ዛለ፤ \q ልቤ በውስጤ ደነዘዘ።
am.B: መንፈሴ በውስጤ ደከመ፤ \q ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠ።
am.R: ደክሜአለሁ፤ ተስፋም ልቆርጥ ነው። \q በውስጤ እጅግ ደንግጫለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए मेरी आत्मा मेरे भीतर मूर्छित होती है; मेरा हृदय मेरे भीतर स्तब्ध है।
hi.B: मेरी आत्मा मेरे भीतर डूबती जाती है, और मेरा हृदय भीतर ही भीतर सुन्न हो गया है।
hi.R: मैं कमज़ोर हो गया हूँ और हार मानने को हूँ। भीतर ही भीतर मैं सदमे में हूँ।

ru.L: И изнемогает во мне мой дух; внутри меня оцепенело моё сердце.
ru.B: Мой дух угасает во мне, и сердце моё внутри застыло от ужаса.
ru.R: Я чувствую себя слабым и готов сдаться. Глубоко внутри я в оцепенении.

ja.L: それで、わたしの霊はわたしのうちで弱り果て、わたしの内で、わたしの心はおののく。
ja.B: わたしの霊はわたしのうちで衰え、わたしの心は、わたしの内でぼう然としている。
ja.R: わたしは弱り果てて、もうあきらめそうだ。心の奥で、わたしはぼう然としている。

uk.L: І знемагає в мені мій дух; посеред мене завмирає моє серце.
uk.B: Мій дух поникає в мені, і моє серце всередині мене приголомшене.
uk.R: Я почуваюся слабким і готовим здатися. Глибоко всередині я в розпачі.

decisions.choice: faints
decisions.reason: As in 142:4 (hit'attef).

decisions.choice: is appalled: is stunned, numb with horror
decisions.reason: The verb (shamem) is to be desolate or stunned, too shocked to act.

decisions.choice: I feel weak and ready to give up
decisions.reason: Readable says what the fainting spirit means in plain words.

decisions.choice: vattit'attef "弱り果て" (L), "衰え" (B), as 142:4
decisions.reason: The same verb with ruchi as in 142:4 takes the same word per level.

source.text: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים׀מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: I remember days from long ago; I meditate on all your doing; on [the] work of your hands I muse.

en.L: I remember [the] days of old; I meditate on all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} doing; on [the] work of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands I ponder.
en.B: I recall the days long past; I think over all that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done and reflect on what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.
en.R: I remember what happened long ago. I think about all that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done. I think hard about the great things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands.

fr.L: Je me souviens des jours d’autrefois ; je médite sur toute {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} œuvre ; sur l’ouvrage de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains je réfléchis.
fr.B: Je me rappelle les jours d’autrefois ; je repasse tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait et je réfléchis à l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains.
fr.R: Je me souviens de ce qui s’est passé il y a longtemps. Je pense à tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait. Je réfléchis aux grandes choses que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains.

sw.L: Ninazikumbuka siku za kale; \q ninatafakari matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote; \q juu ya kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninawaza.
sw.B: Ninazikumbuka siku zilizopita zamani; \q ninayafikiria yote uliyoyatenda \q na kutafakari kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ninakumbuka yaliyotokea zamani. \q Ninafikiria yote uliyotenda. \q Ninawaza sana juu ya mambo makuu uliyoyafanya kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.

es.L: Me acuerdo de [los] días antiguos; medito en todo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} obrar; en [la] obra de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos reflexiono.
es.B: Recuerdo los días de hace mucho; pienso en todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho y reflexiono en lo que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} manos han hecho.
es.R: Recuerdo lo que pasó hace mucho tiempo. Pienso en todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho. Pienso con atención en las grandes cosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos.

vi.L: Tôi nhớ lại [những] ngày xưa; \q tôi suy gẫm mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm; \q tôi ngẫm nghĩ về công việc của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi nhớ lại những ngày xa xưa; \q tôi suy nghĩ về mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, \q và ngẫm nghĩ về những gì tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên.
vi.R: Tôi nhớ lại những gì đã xảy ra từ thuở xa xưa. \q Tôi suy nghĩ về mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm. \q Tôi suy nghĩ thật kỹ về những việc lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm bằng chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 옛날을 기억하고, \q 주님께서 하신 모든 일을 읊조리며, \q 주님의 손이 하신 일을 깊이 생각합니다.
ko.B: 제가 지나간 옛날을 떠올리고, \q 주님께서 하신 모든 일을 되새기며, \q 주님의 손으로 이루신 일을 곰곰이 생각합니다.
ko.R: 저는 오래전에 있었던 일들을 기억합니다. \q 주님께서 하신 모든 일을 생각합니다. \q 주님께서 손수 하신 놀라운 일들을 깊이 생각합니다.

pt.L: Lembro-me [dos] dias de antigamente; medito em todo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} agir; sobre [a] obra das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos reflito.
pt.B: Trago à memória os dias passados há muito tempo; penso em tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste e reflito sobre o que as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos realizaram.
pt.R: Eu me lembro do que aconteceu há muito tempo. Penso em tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste. Penso bastante nas grandes coisas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste com as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} próprias mãos.

am.L: የጥንቱን ዘመን አስታውሳለሁ፤ \q ሥራህን ሁሉ አሰላስላለሁ፤ \q በእጅህ ሥራ አስባለሁ።
am.B: ያለፈውን የጥንት ዘመን አስታውሳለሁ፤ \q ያደረግኸውን ሁሉ አሰላስላለሁ፤ \q እጆችህ የሠሩትንም አስባለሁ።
am.R: ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት የሆነውን አስታውሳለሁ። \q ያደረግኸውን ሁሉ አስባለሁ። \q በገዛ እጆችህ ያደረግሃቸውን ታላላቅ ነገሮች በጥልቅ አስባለሁ።

hi.L: मैं प्राचीन दिनों को स्मरण करता हूँ; मैं तेरे सब कामों पर ध्यान करता हूँ; तेरे हाथों के काम पर मैं मनन करता हूँ।
hi.B: मैं बीते हुए पुराने दिनों को याद करता हूँ; जो कुछ तूने किया है, उस सब पर मैं सोचता हूँ, और तेरे हाथों के कामों पर मनन करता हूँ।
hi.R: मुझे याद आता है कि बहुत पहले क्या हुआ था। मैं उन सब कामों के बारे में सोचता हूँ जो तूने किए हैं। मैं उन महान कामों पर गहराई से सोचता हूँ जो तूने अपने ही हाथों से किए हैं।

ru.L: Я вспоминаю дни древние; я размышляю обо всех {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} деяниях; о деле {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} рук я думаю.
ru.B: Я вспоминаю давно прошедшие дни; я обдумываю всё, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал, и размышляю о том, что сотворили {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} руки.
ru.R: Я вспоминаю, что было давным-давно. Я думаю обо всём, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал. Я долго думаю о великих делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} руками.

ja.L: わたしは昔の日々を思い起こし、あなたのすべてのみわざを口ずさみ、あなたの手のわざを思いめぐらす。
ja.B: わたしは過ぎ去った昔の日々を思い起こし、あなたがなさったすべてのことを小声で唱え、あなたの手が成し遂げたことを思いめぐらす。
ja.R: わたしは、ずっと昔に起こったことを思い出す。あなたがなさったすべてのことを、繰り返し口にする。あなたがその手でなさった偉大なことを、よく考える。

uk.L: Я згадую давні дні; я розмірковую про все {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} діяння; над ділом {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} рук я роздумую.
uk.B: Я пригадую дні, що давно минули; я обмірковую все, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив, і роздумую над тим, що створили {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} руки.
uk.R: Я згадую, що сталося давно. Я думаю про все, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив. Я багато думаю про великі справи, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив своїми власними руками.

decisions.choice: remembering the days of old: as in Psalm 77
decisions.reason: Psalm 77 also turns from despair to remembering God's deeds of long ago (77:6, 12-13), using the same words.

decisions.choice: meditate: think over, murmur to oneself
decisions.reason: As in 1:2, the verb (hagah) is to murmur or think something over.

decisions.choice: the work of your hands: what God has done
decisions.reason: This can be God's creation (8:7; 102:26) or his saving acts for his people (92:5). Here, with "days of old", it is most likely his deeds in Israel's past.

decisions.choice: hagiti "口ずさみ" (L), "小声で唱え" (B), "繰り返し口にする" (R); 'asocheach "思いめぐらす" (L, B), "よく考える" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter words for hagah (PSA-1, 1:2) and siach (PSA-13, 119); remembering the days of old as in Psalm 77 (m1).

source.text: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י׀כְּאֶֽרֶץ־עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: I spread out my hands to you; my soul like a land weary [is] for you. Selah.

en.L: I have spread out my hands to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; my soul [is] like a weary land for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Selah
en.B: I hold out my hands to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; my whole being waits for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} like ground worn out by drought. Selah
en.R: I reach out my hands to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in prayer. I need {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the way dry land needs rain. Selah

fr.L: J’ai étendu mes mains vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; mon âme [est] comme une terre épuisée, vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Sélah
fr.B: Je tends les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; tout mon être {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attend comme une terre épuisée par la sécheresse. Sélah
fr.R: Je tends les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour prier. J’ai besoin de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} comme la terre sèche a besoin de pluie. Sélah

sw.L: Nimekunyooshea mikono yangu; \q nafsi yangu [ni] kama nchi iliyochoka kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Sela
sw.B: Ninakunyooshea mikono yangu; \q nafsi yangu yote inakungoja kama ardhi iliyochoshwa na ukame. Sela
sw.R: Ninakunyooshea mikono yangu kwa maombi. \q Ninakuhitaji kama nchi kavu inavyohitaji mvua. Sela

es.L: He extendido mis manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; mi alma [es] como tierra sedienta de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Selah
es.B: Tiendo mis manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; todo mi ser {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} espera como tierra agotada por la sequía. Selah
es.R: Extiendo mis manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en oración. Te necesito como la tierra seca necesita la lluvia. Selah

vi.L: Tôi đã giơ tay lên hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q linh hồn tôi [khao khát] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như đất khô khan. Sê-la
vi.B: Tôi giơ tay hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q cả con người tôi trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như đất đai cằn cỗi vì hạn hán. Sê-la
vi.R: Tôi giơ tay lên cầu nguyện cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi cần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như đất khô cần mưa. Sê-la

ko.L: 제가 주님을 향하여 제 손을 폅니다. \q 제 영혼이 메마른 땅처럼 주님을 [그리워합니다]. 셀라
ko.B: 제가 주님께 두 손을 내밉니다. \q 가뭄에 지친 땅처럼 제 온 존재가 주님을 기다립니다. 셀라
ko.R: 제가 기도하며 주님께 손을 뻗습니다. \q 메마른 땅이 비를 기다리듯 제게는 주님이 필요합니다. 셀라

pt.L: Estendi as minhas mãos para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; a minha alma [é] como uma terra exausta por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Selá
pt.B: Estendo as minhas mãos para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; todo o meu ser espera por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como um chão esgotado pela seca. Selá
pt.R: Eu estendo as minhas mãos para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em oração. Preciso de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} como a terra seca precisa de chuva. Selá

am.L: እጆቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፤ \q ነፍሴ ለአንተ እንደ ደከመ ምድር [ናት]። ሴላ
am.B: እጆቼን ወደ አንተ እዘረጋለሁ፤ \q ሁለንተናዬ በድርቅ እንደ ዛለ መሬት አንተን ይናፍቃል። ሴላ
am.R: በጸሎት እጆቼን ወደ አንተ እዘረጋለሁ። \q ደረቅ መሬት ዝናብ እንደሚያስፈልገው አንተ ያስፈልገኛል። ሴላ

hi.L: मैंने अपने हाथ तेरी ओर फैलाए हैं; मेरा प्राण तेरे लिए थकी हुई भूमि के समान [है]। सेला
hi.B: मैं अपने हाथ तेरी ओर फैलाता हूँ; सूखे से थकी हुई भूमि के समान मेरा पूरा मन तेरी बाट जोहता है। सेला
hi.R: मैं प्रार्थना में अपने हाथ तेरी ओर फैलाता हूँ। जैसे सूखी भूमि को वर्षा की ज़रूरत होती है, वैसे ही मुझे तेरी ज़रूरत है। सेला

ru.L: Я простёр к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} мои руки; моя душа — как истомлённая земля, [жаждущая] {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Села
ru.B: Я протягиваю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки; всё моё существо ждёт {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, как земля, истощённая засухой. Села
ru.R: Я протягиваю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки в молитве. Ты нужен мне, как сухой земле нужен дождь. Села

ja.L: わたしはあなたに向かって両手を広げた。わたしの魂は、疲れ果てた地のように、あなたを[慕う]。セラ
ja.B: わたしはあなたに両手を差し伸べる。日照りに疲れ果てた地のように、わたしの魂はあなたを待ち望んでいる。セラ
ja.R: わたしは、祈りのために、あなたに両手を差し伸べる。かわいた地が雨を必要とするように、わたしにはあなたが必要だ。セラ

uk.L: Я простягнув мої руки до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; моя душа — як спрагла земля, [прагне] {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Села
uk.B: Я простягаю до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки; усе моє єство чекає на {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, як земля, виснажена посухою. Села
uk.R: Я простягаю до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки в молитві. Я потребую {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} так, як суха земля потребує дощу. Села

decisions.choice: spreading out the hands: a gesture of prayer
decisions.reason: The hands were held out with palms open toward God (44:21; 88:10; 141:2).

decisions.choice: like a weary land: longing for God as dry ground longs for rain
decisions.reason: The same picture is in 63:2: a dry, exhausted land without water. The psalmist thirsts for God.

decisions.choice: worn out by drought (B); the way dry land needs rain (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what makes the land weary, so that the picture of thirst is clear (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sélah", kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As in 140:4: a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music, kept in its French spelling.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse, as in Psalm 140
decisions.reason: No one now knows what Selah means; it is probably a direction for the music (see the meaning decision). It stands where the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: "셀라" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As at 140:4: a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: मेरा प्राण (L); मेरा पूरा मन (B); मुझे (R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh is प्राण at Literal; Balanced and Readable say the whole self, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Села" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As in 140:4: the meaning of the word is unknown (m3), so every level keeps it as a word at the end of its verse.

decisions.choice: "[慕う]" (L), "日照りに…待ち望んでいる" (B), "雨を必要とする" (R) supplied
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb (m2); B and R supply the drought and the rain as the English does (r-en-1). Selah セラ (uncertain, m3).

source.text: מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨נִי׀יְהוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֪ה ר֫וּחִ֥י אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Quickly answer me, YHWH; it is spent, my spirit. Do not hide your face from me, or I will be like those going down [to the] pit.

en.L: Quickly answer me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; my spirit is spent. Do not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from me, or I will become like those who go down [to the] pit.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hurry and answer me; my spirit is failing. Do not keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face hidden from me, or I will become one of those who sink into the pit.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, answer me quickly. I cannot hold on much longer. Do not turn away from me, or I will die like everyone who goes down to the grave.

fr.L: Vite, réponds-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; mon esprit s’épuise. Ne cache pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face loin de moi, sinon je deviendrai comme ceux qui descendent [dans] la fosse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, hâte-toi de me répondre ; mon esprit défaille. Ne garde pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face cachée loin de moi, sinon je serai de ceux qui sombrent dans la fosse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, réponds-moi vite. Je ne peux plus tenir très longtemps. Ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détourne pas de moi, sinon je vais mourir comme tous ceux qui descendent dans la tombe.

sw.L: Unijibu upesi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; roho yangu imekwisha. \q Usinifiche uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q la sivyo nitakuwa kama wale wanaoshuka [shimoni].
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uharakishe kunijibu; roho yangu inazimia. \q Usiendelee kunificha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q la sivyo nitakuwa mmoja wa wale wanaozama shimoni.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unijibu upesi. Siwezi kuvumilia muda mrefu zaidi. \q Usinigeuzie mgongo, \q la sivyo nitakufa kama kila mtu anayeshuka kaburini.

es.L: Respóndeme pronto, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; mi espíritu se agota. No escondas de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, o seré como los que descienden a [la] fosa.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, apúrate a responderme; mi espíritu desfallece. No mantengas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro escondido de mí, o seré uno de los que se hunden en la fosa.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, respóndeme pronto. Ya no puedo aguantar mucho más. No te alejes de mí, o moriré como todos los que bajan a la tumba.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau đáp lời tôi; tâm linh tôi đã kiệt quệ. \q Xin đừng ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi tôi, \q kẻo tôi sẽ giống như những kẻ đi xuống [huyệt] mộ.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau đáp lời tôi; tâm linh tôi đang lịm dần. \q Xin đừng giấu mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi tôi, \q kẻo tôi trở nên như những kẻ chìm xuống huyệt sâu.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mau trả lời tôi. Tôi không thể chịu đựng lâu hơn nữa. \q Xin đừng quay mặt khỏi tôi, \q kẻo tôi chết như mọi người đi xuống mồ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 속히 제게 응답하여 주십시오. 제 영이 다하였습니다. \q 주님의 얼굴을 제게서 숨기지 마십시오. \q [그러면] 제가 구덩이로 내려가는 자들과 같아질 것입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 어서 제게 응답하여 주십시오. 제 영이 꺼져 갑니다. \q 주님의 얼굴을 제게서 감추지 마십시오. \q 그러시면 제가 구덩이로 내려가는 자들 가운데 하나가 될 것입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 빨리 대답해 주십시오. 저는 더 이상 버틸 수 없습니다. \q 저에게서 얼굴을 돌리지 마십시오. \q 그러시면 저는 무덤으로 내려가는 모든 사람처럼 죽고 말 것입니다.

pt.L: Depressa responde-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}; o meu espírito se esgota. Não escondas de mim a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face, ou serei como os que descem [à] cova.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, apressa-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} e responde-me; o meu espírito está desfalecendo. Não mantenhas a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face escondida de mim, ou serei como os que afundam na cova.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, responde-me depressa. Não aguento mais muito tempo. Não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} afastes de mim, ou vou morrer como todos os que descem para a sepultura.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ መልስልኝ፤ መንፈሴ አለቀ። \q ፊትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር፤ \q ወደ ጉድጓድ እንደሚወርዱት እንዳልሆን።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ መልስልኝ፤ መንፈሴ ደክሟል። \q ፊትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር፤ \q አለዚያ ወደ ጉድጓድ እንደሚሰምጡት እሆናለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፈጥነህ መልስልኝ። ከዚህ በላይ መቋቋም አልችልም። \q ፊትህን ከእኔ አታዙር፤ \q አለዚያ ወደ መቃብር እንደሚወርዱት ሁሉ እሞታለሁ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, फुर्ती से मुझे उत्तर दे; मेरी आत्मा क्षीण हो गई है। अपना मुख मुझसे न छिपा, नहीं तो मैं गड्ढे में उतरनेवालों के समान हो जाऊँगा।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जल्दी मुझे उत्तर दे; मेरी आत्मा जवाब दे रही है। अपना मुख मुझसे छिपाए न रख, नहीं तो मैं क़ब्र में उतरनेवालों में से एक हो जाऊँगा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जल्दी मुझे उत्तर दे। मैं अब और अधिक नहीं सह सकता। मुझसे मुँह न मोड़, नहीं तो मैं भी उन सब की तरह मर जाऊँगा जो क़ब्र में उतर जाते हैं।

ru.L: Скорее ответь мне, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; иссяк мой дух. Не скрывай {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} лица от меня, иначе я стану подобен нисходящим в яму.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, поспеши ответить мне; мой дух изнемогает. Не прячь от меня {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} лица, иначе я стану одним из тех, кто опускается в могилу.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ответь мне скорее. Я больше не могу держаться. Не отворачивайся от меня, иначе я умру, как все, кто сходит в могилу.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、急いでわたしに答えてください。わたしの霊は尽き果てた。あなたの顔をわたしから隠さないでください。わたしが穴に下る者たちのようにならないように。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、早くわたしに答えてください。わたしの霊は衰え果てている。あなたの顔を、わたしから隠したままにしないでください。さもないと、わたしは穴に沈んでいく者たちの一人となってしまう。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、すぐに答えてください。わたしは、もうこれ以上もちこたえられない。わたしから顔をそむけないでください。そうでないと、わたしは、死の穴に下って行く人たちのように死んでしまう。

uk.L: Швидко відповідай мені, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}; мій дух знемагає. Не ховай від мене {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} обличчя, бо я стану подібний до тих, хто сходить [у] яму.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, поспіши відповісти мені; мій дух слабне. Не ховай від мене {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} обличчя, бо я стану одним із тих, хто опускається в могилу.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, відповідай мені швидко. Я вже не можу довго триматися. Не відвертайся від мене, бо я помру, як усі, хто сходить у могилу.

decisions.choice: hide your face: turn away, withhold help
decisions.reason: God's face turned toward someone means favor; hidden, it means he seems absent (13:2; 27:9; 102:3).

decisions.choice: those who go down to the pit: as in 28:1
decisions.reason: The same words close 28:1. The pit is the grave, the way down to the dead (30:4; 88:5).

decisions.choice: I cannot hold on much longer
decisions.reason: Readable says what the failing spirit means in plain words.

decisions.choice: do not turn away from me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: os que descem [à] cova (L); os que afundam na cova (B)
decisions.reason: The words that close 28:1 (m2), as that verse's Portuguese has them.

decisions.choice: "ወደ ጉድጓድ እንደሚወርዱት" (L), "ወደ ጉድጓድ እንደሚሰምጡት" (B)
decisions.reason: The same words close 28:1 (meaning decision m2); the Amharic of 28:1 is kept.

decisions.choice: गड्ढा (L); क़ब्र (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Pit is गड्ढा at Literal and क़ब्र at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: яма (L); могила (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Pit, the grave (m2), is "яма" at Literal and "могила" at Balanced and Readable, as settled for the Psalms.

decisions.choice: yordei vor "穴に下る者たち" (L, B), "死の穴に下って行く人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rule: bor is 穴 (L, B), 死の穴 (R), also where the English R says grave (as 28:1, m2).

source.text: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי בַבֹּ֨קֶר׀חַסְדֶּךָ֮ כִּֽי־בְךָ֪ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: Make me hear in the morning your loyal love, for in you I have trusted; make known to me [the] way which I should walk, for to you I lift up my soul.

en.L: Let me hear {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love in the morning, for in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have trusted; make known to me [the] way [in] which I should walk, for to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I lift up my soul.
en.B: Each morning let me hear of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, since {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one I rely on. Teach me which road to walk, for my whole being reaches up to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: In the morning, let me hear about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, because I trust {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Show me which way to go, because I long for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart.

fr.L: Fais-moi entendre le matin {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, car en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} j’ai mis ma confiance ; fais-moi connaître [le] chemin où je dois marcher, car vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} j’élève mon âme.
fr.B: Chaque matin, fais-moi entendre parler de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, puisque c’est sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je compte. Enseigne-moi quel chemin prendre, car tout mon être se tend vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Le matin, laisse-moi entendre parler de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, parce que j’ai confiance en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Montre-moi quel chemin suivre, parce que je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} désire de tout mon cœur.

sw.L: Unisikizishe upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma asubuhi, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} nimetumaini; \q unijulishe njia [ambayo] nipaswa kutembea, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ninainua nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Kila asubuhi unisikizishe habari za upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa kuwa ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ninayekutegemea. \q Unifundishe njia nipaswayo kuiendea, \q kwa maana nafsi yangu yote inakuelekea {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.R: Asubuhi, unijulishe habari za upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa sababu ninakutumaini. \q Unionyeshe njia ya kufuata, \q kwa sababu ninakutamani kwa moyo wangu wote.

es.L: Hazme oír por la mañana {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, porque en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} he confiado; hazme conocer [el] camino [por el] que debo andar, porque a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} elevo mi alma.
es.B: Cada mañana hazme oír de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, ya que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres en quien me apoyo. Enséñame qué camino seguir, porque todo mi ser se eleva hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Por la mañana, déjame oír de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, porque confío en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Muéstrame por dónde ir, porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} anhelo con todo mi corazón.

vi.L: Xin cho tôi nghe tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào buổi sáng, vì tôi đã tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q xin cho tôi biết con đường tôi phải đi, \q vì tôi nâng linh hồn tôi lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mỗi buổi sáng, xin cho tôi được nghe về tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tôi nương cậy. \q Xin dạy tôi con đường phải đi, \q vì cả con người tôi vươn lên hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vào buổi sáng, xin cho tôi nghe về tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì tôi tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin chỉ cho tôi con đường phải đi, \q vì tôi hết lòng khao khát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 아침에 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 제가 듣게 하여 주십시오. 제가 주님을 신뢰하였기 때문입니다. \q 제가 걸어가야 할 길을 제게 알려 주십시오. \q 제가 주님께 제 영혼을 들어 올리기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 아침마다 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 제가 듣게 하여 주십시오. 제가 의지하는 분은 주님이시기 때문입니다. \q 제가 걸어야 할 길을 가르쳐 주십시오. \q 제 온 존재가 주님을 향해 올라갑니다.
ko.R: 아침에 주님의 변함없는 사랑에 대해 듣게 해 주십시오. 저는 주님을 믿고 의지합니다. \q 제가 어느 길로 가야 할지 보여 주십시오. \q 저는 온 마음으로 주님을 간절히 바랍니다.

pt.L: Faze-me ouvir o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal pela manhã, pois em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} confiei; faze-me conhecer [o] caminho [por onde] devo andar, pois a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} elevo a minha alma.
pt.B: Cada manhã, deixa-me ouvir falar do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, pois é em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} que me apoio. Ensina-me por qual estrada andar, porque todo o meu ser se ergue para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: De manhã, deixa-me ouvir sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel, porque eu confio em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Mostra-me o caminho que devo seguir, porque desejo estar {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}} de todo o coração.

am.L: ጽኑ ፍቅርህን በማለዳ አሰማኝ፤ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና። \q የምሄድበትን መንገድ አስታውቀኝ፤ \q ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁና።
am.B: በየማለዳው ጽኑ ፍቅርህን አሰማኝ፤ የምመካው በአንተ ነውና። \q የምሄድበትን መንገድ አስተምረኝ፤ \q ሁለንተናዬን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁና።
am.R: በማለዳ ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ አሰማኝ፤ በአንተ እታመናለሁ። \q የምሄድበትን መንገድ አሳየኝ። \q በሙሉ ልቤ አንተን እናፍቃለሁ።

hi.L: भोर को मुझे अपना अटल प्रेम सुनने दे, क्योंकि मैंने तुझ पर भरोसा रखा है; जिस मार्ग पर मुझे चलना चाहिए, वह मुझे बता, क्योंकि मैं अपना प्राण तेरी ओर उठाता हूँ।
hi.B: हर भोर मुझे तेरे अटल प्रेम का समाचार मिले, क्योंकि तू ही है जिस पर मैं भरोसा रखता हूँ। मुझे सिखा कि मैं किस मार्ग पर चलूँ, क्योंकि मेरा पूरा मन तेरी ओर उठता है।
hi.R: भोर को मुझे तेरे अटल प्रेम के बारे में सुनने दे, क्योंकि मैं तुझ पर भरोसा रखता हूँ। मुझे दिखा कि मैं किस रास्ते पर जाऊँ, क्योंकि मैं पूरे मन से तेरी लालसा करता हूँ।

ru.L: Дай мне услышать утром {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} неизменную любовь, ведь на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я уповаю; дай мне узнать путь, [по] которому мне идти, ведь к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я возношу мою душу.
ru.B: Каждое утро дай мне слышать о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — тот, на кого я полагаюсь. Научи меня, по какой дороге идти, потому что всё моё существо тянется к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
ru.R: Утром дай мне услышать о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви, потому что я доверяю {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Покажи мне, куда идти, потому что я всем сердцем стремлюсь к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: 朝に、あなたの誠実をわたしに聞かせてください。わたしはあなたに信頼しているからである。わたしが歩むべき道を、わたしに知らせてください。わたしはあなたに、わたしの魂を上げるからである。
ja.B: 朝ごとに、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみを聞かせてください。わたしが信頼しているのは、あなただから。どの道を歩めばよいかを教えてください。わたしの魂は、あなたを仰ぎ求めているから。
ja.R: 朝には、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみについて聞かせてください。わたしはあなたを信頼しているから。どちらの道を行けばよいか、教えてください。わたしは心から、あなたを慕い求めているから。

uk.L: Дай мені почути вранці {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} незмінну любов, бо на {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я поклався; дай мені пізнати дорогу, [якою] мені йти, бо до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я підношу мою душу.
uk.B: Щоранку дай мені почути про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} незмінну любов, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — той, на кого я покладаюся. Навчи мене, якою дорогою йти, бо все моє єство тягнеться до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: Уранці дай мені почути про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} вірну любов, бо я довіряю {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}. Покажи мені, куди йти, бо я всім серцем прагну {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, committed love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith with a bond or covenant. It is "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, as in 5:8.

decisions.choice: in the morning: with the new day, after a night of trouble
decisions.reason: Help comes with the morning (46:6; 90:14).

decisions.choice: lift up my soul: turn my whole desire to you
decisions.reason: As in 25:1 and 86:4, the psalmist turns his whole self toward God in longing and trust.

decisions.choice: my whole being reaches up to you (B); I long for you with all my heart (R)
alternatives: to you I lift up my soul
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m3).

decisions.choice: "ጽኑ ፍቅር" for chesed at every level
decisions.reason: The terms list's word for chesed; Readable keeps it for the English Readable "faithful love", as the Amharic glossary sets it.

decisions.choice: अटल प्रेम at every level
decisions.reason: God's hesed is अटल प्रेम at every level, as the poetry note settles; the English Readable's "faithful love" is the same word.

decisions.choice: chasdekha "あなたの誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R); nasa'ti nafshi "わたしの魂を上げる" (L), "魂は…仰ぎ求めている" (B), "心から…慕い求めている" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter hesed rule (PSA-1); lifting up the soul is turning one's whole desire to God (m3).

records.literal_gloss: Deliver me from my enemies, YHWH; to you I have covered.

en.L: Deliver me from my enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have hidden myself.
en.B: Snatch me from my enemies, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; I have taken cover with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save me from my enemies. I have come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to hide.

fr.L: Délivre-moi de mes ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je me suis caché.
fr.B: Arrache-moi à mes ennemis, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’est auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’ai trouvé un abri.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve-moi de mes ennemis. Je suis venu vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour me cacher.

sw.L: Uniokoe na adui zangu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} nimejificha.
sw.B: Uninyakue mikononi mwa adui zangu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nimejificha {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uniokoe na adui zangu. \q Nimekuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili nijifiche.

es.L: Líbrame de mis enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he escondido.
es.B: Arrebátame de mis enemigos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; me he puesto a cubierto contigo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sálvame de mis enemigos. He venido a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para esconderme.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ thù tôi; \q tôi đã ẩn mình nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giật tôi ra khỏi tay kẻ thù; \q tôi đã tìm chỗ ẩn núp nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu tôi khỏi kẻ thù. \q Tôi đã đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để ẩn mình.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 원수들에게서 저를 건져 주십시오. \q 제가 주님께 몸을 숨겼습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 원수들에게서 저를 낚아채어 건져 주십시오. \q 제가 주님께 피하여 숨었습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 원수들에게서 저를 구해 주십시오. \q 제가 숨으려고 주님께 왔습니다.

pt.L: Livra-me dos meus inimigos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}; junto a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} eu me escondi.
pt.B: Arranca-me das mãos dos meus inimigos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}; eu me abriguei em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, salva-me dos meus inimigos. Eu vim até {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para me esconder.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ፤ \q በአንተ ዘንድ ተሸሸግኩ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ከጠላቶቼ ነጥቀህ አድነኝ፤ \q በአንተ ዘንድ ተጠግቻለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ። \q ልደበቅ ወደ አንተ መጥቻለሁ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से छुड़ा; मैंने तेरे पास अपने को छिपाया है।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से छीन ले; मैंने तेरे पास आड़ ली है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे मेरे शत्रुओं से बचा। मैं छिपने के लिए तेरे पास आया हूँ।

ru.L: Избавь меня от моих врагов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я укрылся.
ru.B: Вырви меня из рук моих врагов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; я нашёл укрытие у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, спаси меня от моих врагов. Я пришёл к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, чтобы спрятаться.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの敵たちから、わたしを救い出してください。あなたのもとに、わたしは身を隠した。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、敵たちの手から、わたしを救い出してください。わたしは、あなたのもとに隠れ場を求めた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、敵たちから、わたしを救ってください。わたしは、隠れるために、あなたのところに来た。

uk.L: Визволи мене від моїх ворогів, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}; у {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я сховався.
uk.B: Вирви мене з рук моїх ворогів, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}; я знайшов сховок у {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, урятуй мене від моїх ворогів. Я прийшов до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, щоб сховатися.

decisions.choice: I have covered: I have hidden myself with you
alternatives: I have fled to you (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew (kissiti, "I have covered") is unusual here; it most likely means "I have hidden myself" with God. The ancient Greek translation has "I have fled to you", perhaps from a word that differs by one letter.

decisions.choice: deliver: snatch away, rescue
decisions.reason: The verb (natsal) is to pull someone out of danger (7:2; 142:7).

decisions.choice: khissiti "身を隠した" (L), "隠れ場を求めた" (B), "隠れるために…来た" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is read as 'I have hidden myself with you' (m1, uncertain); hatsileni "救い出してください" (L, B) as the Psalter's natsal.

source.text: לַמְּדֵ֤נִי׀לַֽעֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Teach me to do your will, for you [are] my God; your spirit [is] good; may it lead me in a land of level ground.

en.L: Teach me to do {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] my God; may {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} good Spirit lead me in a land of level ground.
en.B: Teach me to do what pleases {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, since {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are my God. May {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Spirit, who is good, guide me across even ground.
en.R: Teach me to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are my God. Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} good Spirit lead me on a smooth, safe path.

fr.L: Enseigne-moi à faire {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté, car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] mon Dieu ; que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bon Esprit me conduise dans une terre de plaine.
fr.B: Enseigne-moi à faire ce qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, puisque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es mon Dieu. Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Esprit, qui est bon, me guide sur un terrain uni.
fr.R: Apprends-moi à faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es mon Dieu. Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bon Esprit me conduise sur un chemin plat et sûr.

sw.L: Unifundishe kufanya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] Mungu wangu; \q Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwema na aniongoze katika nchi ya uwanda.
sw.B: Unifundishe kutenda yanayokupendeza, kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Mungu wangu. \q Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, aliye mwema, \q aniongoze katika ardhi tambarare.
sw.R: Unifundishe kufanya unachotaka, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Mungu wangu. \q Roho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwema aniongoze katika njia laini na salama.

es.L: Enséñame a hacer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] mi Dios; que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} buen Espíritu me guíe por una tierra llana.
es.B: Enséñame a hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agrada, ya que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres mi Dios. Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Espíritu, que es bueno, me guíe por terreno llano.
es.R: Enséñame a hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres mi Dios. Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} buen Espíritu me lleve por un camino llano y seguro.

vi.L: Xin dạy tôi làm theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của tôi; \q nguyện Thần Linh tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn tôi vào vùng đất bằng phẳng.
vi.B: Xin dạy tôi làm điều đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Nguyện Thần Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là Đấng tốt lành, dẫn dắt tôi trên đất bằng phẳng.
vi.R: Xin dạy tôi làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Nguyện Thần Linh tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn tôi đi trên con đường bằng phẳng và an toàn.

ko.L: 주님의 뜻을 행하도록 저를 가르쳐 주십시오. 주님은 저의 하나님이시기 때문입니다. \q 주님의 선하신 영이 평탄한 땅으로 저를 인도하시기를 [바랍니다].
ko.B: 주님을 기쁘시게 하는 일을 행하도록 저를 가르쳐 주십시오. \q 주님은 저의 하나님이십니다. \q 선하신 주님의 영이 평탄한 길로 저를 이끄시기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 원하시는 일을 하도록 저를 가르쳐 주십시오. 주님은 저의 하나님이십니다. \q 주님의 선하신 영이 평탄하고 안전한 길로 저를 이끌어 주시게 하십시오.

pt.L: Ensina-me a fazer a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade, pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és] o meu Deus; que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} bom Espírito me conduza numa terra plana.
pt.B: Ensina-me a fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agrada, pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o meu Deus. Que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} Espírito, que é bom, me guie por terreno plano.
pt.R: Ensina-me a fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o meu Deus. Que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} bom Espírito me conduza por um caminho plano e seguro.

am.L: ፈቃድህን አደርግ ዘንድ አስተምረኝ፤ አንተ አምላኬ [ነህ]ና፤ \q መልካሙ መንፈስህ በደልዳላ ምድር ይምራኝ።
am.B: ደስ የሚያሰኝህን አደርግ ዘንድ አስተምረኝ፤ \q አንተ አምላኬ ነህና። \q መልካም የሆነው መንፈስህ በደልዳላ ምድር ይምራኝ።
am.R: የምትፈልገውን እንዳደርግ አስተምረኝ፤ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ። \q መልካሙ መንፈስህ ደልዳላና አስተማማኝ በሆነ መንገድ ይምራኝ።

hi.L: मुझे अपनी इच्छा पर चलना सिखा, क्योंकि तू मेरा परमेश्वर [है]; तेरा भला आत्मा मुझे समतल भूमि में ले चले।
hi.B: मुझे वह करना सिखा जो तुझे भाता है, क्योंकि तू मेरा परमेश्वर है। तेरा आत्मा, जो भला है, मुझे समतल भूमि पर से ले चले।
hi.R: मुझे वह करना सिखा जो तू चाहता है, क्योंकि तू मेरा परमेश्वर है। तेरा भला आत्मा मुझे समतल और सुरक्षित रास्ते पर ले चले।

ru.L: Научи меня исполнять {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} волю, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — мой Бог; пусть {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} благой Дух ведёт меня в земле ровной.
ru.B: Научи меня делать то, что угодно {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — мой Бог. Пусть {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Дух, который благ, ведёт меня по ровной земле.
ru.R: Научи меня делать то, чего {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хочешь, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — мой Бог. Пусть {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} добрый Дух ведёт меня по ровному и безопасному пути.

ja.L: あなたのみこころを行うことを、わたしに教えてください。あなたはわたしの神だからである。あなたの良い霊が、平らな地にわたしを導くように。
ja.B: あなたのお喜びになることを行えるように、わたしに教えてください。あなたはわたしの神だから。恵み深いあなたの霊が、わたしを平らな地に導いてくださるように。
ja.R: あなたがお望みになることを行えるように、教えてください。あなたはわたしの神だから。あなたの良い霊が、平らで安全な道に、わたしを導いてくださるように。

uk.L: Навчи мене виконувати {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} волю, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — мій Бог; нехай {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} добрий Дух веде мене в землі рівнинній.
uk.B: Навчи мене робити те, що {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} до вподоби, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — мій Бог. Нехай {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} Дух, який добрий, веде мене рівною землею.
uk.R: Навчи мене робити те, чого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} хочеш, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — мій Бог. Нехай {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} добрий Дух веде мене рівною, безпечною стежкою.

decisions.choice: your good spirit: God's own Spirit guiding him
decisions.reason: God's spirit is his presence and power at work (51:13; 139:7). Nehemiah 9:20 also speaks of the "good spirit" God gave to instruct Israel. As in 51:13, it is capitalized. The words can also be read "your spirit is good; let it lead me".

decisions.choice: a land of level ground: a smooth, safe way
decisions.reason: Level ground is a path without obstacles or traps, a picture of a life kept upright and safe (26:12; 27:11).

decisions.choice: your will: what pleases you
decisions.reason: The word (ratson) is what someone delights in or wants (40:9).

decisions.choice: a smooth, safe path
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Ngài" (your Spirit), capitalised, as Psalm 139:7
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes this as God's own Spirit guiding him; as in the published Psalm 139:7, "Thần Linh" with a capital names God's Spirit without adding "holy", which the Hebrew does not say.

decisions.choice: "주님의 선하신 영", with the honorific
decisions.reason: The English reads God's own Spirit (meaning decision); the honorific "-신" marks this in Korean without naming the Holy Spirit, which the Hebrew does not.

decisions.choice: "አምላኬ" (my God) for Elohim with a possessor
decisions.reason: As the Psalms agree for Elohim: "አምላክ" with a possessive suffix and in address, "እግዚአብሔር" where the psalm speaks of the one God without one.

decisions.choice: तेरा भला आत्मा (masculine)
decisions.reason: God's Spirit takes masculine agreement, as in 139:7 and the New Testament in this translation; the psalmist's own spirit (verses 4 and 7) is feminine.

decisions.choice: ruchakha tovah "あなたの良い霊" (L, R), "恵み深いあなたの霊" (B), not "聖霊"
decisions.reason: God's own Spirit guiding him (m1, uncertain); as 139:7 the Psalter keeps "あなたの霊". retsonekha "みこころ" (L) as 103:21; "お喜びになる" / "お望みになる" avoid passive-looking forms.

source.text: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓׀תוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of your name, YHWH, you will keep me alive; in your righteousness you will bring out from trouble my soul.

en.L: For the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, keep me alive; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, keep me alive; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness lead me out of my distress.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, keep me alive and show everyone what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are like. You always do what is right, so bring me out of my trouble.

fr.L: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-moi vivre ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice fais sortir mon âme de la détresse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, garde-moi en vie ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice, fais-moi sortir de ma détresse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, garde-moi en vie et montre à tous qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es. Tu fais toujours ce qui est juste : alors fais-moi sortir de mon malheur.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unihifadhi hai; \q kwa haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uitoe nafsi yangu katika taabu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, unihifadhi hai; \q kwa haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} unitoe katika dhiki yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unihifadhi hai na uwaonyeshe watu wote jinsi ulivyo. \q Wewe hutenda yaliyo haki daima, kwa hiyo unitoe katika taabu yangu.

es.L: Por amor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, dame vida; por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia saca mi alma de la angustia.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por la honra de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, mantenme con vida; por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia sácame de mi angustia.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, mantenme con vida y muéstrale a todos cómo eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. Tú siempre haces lo correcto; por eso, sácame de mi problema.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì cớ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin giữ tôi sống; \q trong sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin đem linh hồn tôi ra khỏi cơn hoạn nạn.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì danh dự của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin giữ mạng sống tôi; \q bởi sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin dẫn tôi ra khỏi cảnh khốn cùng.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giữ cho tôi sống và cho mọi người thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng thể nào. \q Ngài luôn làm điều công chính, vậy xin đem tôi ra khỏi cơn hoạn nạn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름을 위하여 저를 살려 주십시오. \q 주님의 의로 제 영혼을 고난에서 이끌어 내어 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름의 영광을 위하여 저를 살려 주십시오. \q 주님의 의로 저를 이 괴로움에서 이끌어 내 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 살려 주셔서 주님께서 어떤 분이신지 모든 사람에게 보여 주십시오. \q 주님은 언제나 옳은 일을 하시니, 저를 이 어려움에서 건져 주십시오.

pt.L: Por amor do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, conserva-me a vida; na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça tira a minha alma da angústia.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, pela honra do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, conserva-me a vida; na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça tira-me da minha aflição.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mantém-me vivo e mostra a todos como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és. Tu sempre fazes o que é certo; então tira-me da minha aflição.

am.L: ስለ ስምህ ብለህ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ \q በጽድቅህ ነፍሴን ከጭንቀት አውጣ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለስምህ ክብር ስትል በሕይወት አኑረኝ፤ \q በጽድቅህ ከጭንቀቴ አውጣኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሕይወት አኑረኝ፤ ማንነትህንም ለሰዎች ሁሉ አሳይ። \q አንተ ሁልጊዜ ትክክል የሆነውን ታደርጋለህ፤ ስለዚህ ከመከራዬ አውጣኝ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने नाम के निमित्त मुझे जीवित रख; अपनी धार्मिकता में मेरे प्राण को संकट से निकाल।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने नाम के आदर के लिए मुझे जीवित रख; अपनी धार्मिकता में मुझे मेरे संकट से बाहर ले आ।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे जीवित रख और सबको दिखा कि तू कैसा है। तू सदा वही करता है जो सही है, इसलिए मुझे मेरी मुसीबत से निकाल।

ru.L: Ради {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, сохрани мне жизнь; по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности выведи мою душу из беды.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ради чести {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени сохрани мне жизнь; по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности выведи меня из моей беды.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, сохрани мне жизнь и покажи всем, какой {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}. Ты всегда поступаешь справедливо, поэтому выведи меня из моей беды.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名のゆえに、わたしを生かしてください。あなたの義によって、わたしの魂を苦難から連れ出してください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名の誉れのために、わたしを生かしてください。あなたの義によって、苦しみの中からわたしを連れ出してください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを生かして、あなたがどのような方であるかを、みんなに示してください。あなたはいつも正しいことをなさる。だから、わたしを苦しみから救い出してください。

uk.L: Заради {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, збережи мене живим; у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} праведності виведи мою душу з біди.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, заради честі {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} імені збережи мені життя; у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} праведності виведи мене з моєї скрути.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, збережи мені життя й покажи всім, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} є. Ти завжди чиниш правильно, тож виведи мене з моєї біди.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name: for your honor
decisions.reason: God's name is his reputation. When he saves those who trust him, people see who he is (23:3; 25:11; 106:8).

decisions.choice: you will keep me alive: a request
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the future form but carry the sense of a prayer, as the rest of the psalm shows.

decisions.choice: show everyone what you are like
alternatives: for the sake of your name
decisions.reason: Readable says what "for your name's sake" means (m1).

decisions.choice: you always do what is right
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: techayyeni / totsi' as requests "生かしてください" / "連れ出してください"
decisions.reason: The imperfects are a request (m2), so the Psalter's 〜てください form is used. chayyeni as in Psalm 119 ("生かしてください" L, B).

source.text: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And in your loyal love you will destroy my enemies, and you will destroy all [the] foes of my soul, for I [am] your servant.

en.L: And in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will cut off my enemies and destroy all the foes of my soul, for I [am] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will put an end to my enemies and wipe out all who attack my life, for I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.R: Because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} love me faithfully, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will destroy my enemies. You will get rid of all who are against me, because I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.

fr.L: Et dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} retrancheras mes ennemis et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} feras périr tous les adversaires de mon âme, car moi, [je suis] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mettras fin à mes ennemis et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} anéantiras tous ceux qui en veulent à ma vie, car je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.R: Parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’aimes d’un amour fidèle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} détruiras mes ennemis. Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} débarrasseras de tous ceux qui sont contre moi, parce que je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Na kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma utawakatilia mbali adui zangu \q na kuwaangamiza watesi wote wa nafsi yangu, \q kwa maana mimi [ni] mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma utawakomesha adui zangu \q na kuwaangamiza wote wanaoyashambulia maisha yangu, \q kwa maana mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Kwa sababu unanipenda kwa upendo usiokoma, utawaangamiza adui zangu. \q Utawaondoa wote walio kinyume changu, \q kwa sababu mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: Y por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} destruirás a mis enemigos y harás perecer a todos los adversarios de mi alma, porque yo [soy] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.B: Por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} acabarás con mis enemigos y destruirás a todos los que atacan mi vida, porque yo soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me amas fielmente, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} destruirás a mis enemigos. Acabarás con todos los que están contra mí, porque yo soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

vi.L: Và trong tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ diệt trừ các kẻ thù tôi và tiêu diệt mọi kẻ đối địch linh hồn tôi, \q vì tôi [là] đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dẹp bỏ các kẻ thù tôi và tiêu diệt mọi kẻ tấn công mạng sống tôi, \q vì tôi là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu thương tôi không hề thay đổi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiêu diệt kẻ thù của tôi. \q Ngài sẽ dẹp bỏ mọi kẻ chống lại tôi, \q vì tôi là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로 제 원수들을 끊어 버리시고, \q 제 영혼의 모든 대적을 멸하실 것입니다. \q 저는 주님의 종이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로 제 원수들을 없애시고, \q 제 목숨을 노리는 모든 자를 멸하실 것입니다. \q 저는 주님의 종이기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 변함없이 사랑하시니 제 원수들을 멸하실 것입니다. \q 저를 대적하는 사람들을 모두 없애 버리실 것입니다. \q 저는 주님의 종이기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} exterminarás os meus inimigos e destruirás todos os adversários da minha alma, pois eu [sou] o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.B: No {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} darás fim aos meus inimigos e acabarás com todos os que atacam a minha vida, pois eu sou o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.R: Como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me amas com fidelidade, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais destruir os meus inimigos. Tu vais acabar com todos os que estão contra mim, porque eu sou o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

am.L: በጽኑ ፍቅርህም ጠላቶቼን ታጠፋለህ፤ \q የነፍሴንም ባላጋራዎች ሁሉ ትደመስሳለህ፤ \q እኔ ባሪያህ [ነኝ]ና።
am.B: በጽኑ ፍቅርህ ጠላቶቼን ታጠፋለህ፤ \q ሕይወቴን የሚያጠቁትንም ሁሉ ትደመስሳለህ፤ \q እኔ አገልጋይህ ነኝና።
am.R: በጽኑ ፍቅር ስለምትወደኝ ጠላቶቼን ታጠፋለህ። \q የሚቃወሙኝን ሁሉ ታስወግዳለህ፤ \q እኔ አገልጋይህ ነኝና።

hi.L: और अपने अटल प्रेम में तू मेरे शत्रुओं को मिटा देगा, और मेरे प्राण के सब बैरियों को नष्ट करेगा, क्योंकि मैं तेरा दास [हूँ]।
hi.B: अपने अटल प्रेम के कारण तू मेरे शत्रुओं का अंत कर देगा और मेरे प्राण पर हमला करनेवाले सब लोगों को मिटा डालेगा, क्योंकि मैं तेरा दास हूँ।
hi.R: क्योंकि तू मुझसे अटल प्रेम रखता है, तू मेरे शत्रुओं को नष्ट कर देगा। जो मेरे विरुद्ध हैं, तू उन सबको हटा देगा, क्योंकि मैं तेरा दास हूँ।

ru.L: И по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} истребишь моих врагов и погубишь всех противников моей души, ведь я — {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} раб.
ru.B: По {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} положишь конец моим врагам и уничтожишь всех, кто покушается на мою жизнь, ведь я — {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} раб.
ru.R: Потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} неизменно любишь меня, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} уничтожишь моих врагов. Ты избавишься от всех, кто против меня, потому что я — {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} раб.

ja.L: そして、あなたの誠実によって、わたしの敵たちを断ち、わたしの魂の仇をことごとく滅ぼしてくださる。わたしはあなたのしもべだからである。
ja.B: あなたの変わらぬいつくしみによって、あなたはわたしの敵たちを絶ち、わたしの命をねらう仇をみな滅ぼしてくださる。わたしはあなたのしもべだから。
ja.R: あなたは変わらぬいつくしみによって、わたしの敵を滅ぼしてくださる。わたしに逆らう人たちを、みな取り除いてくださる。わたしは、あなたのしもべだから。

uk.L: І в {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} незмінній любові {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знищиш моїх ворогів і погубиш усіх супротивників моєї душі, бо я — {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} раб.
uk.B: У {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} незмінній любові {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} покладеш край моїм ворогам і знищиш усіх, хто нападає на моє життя, бо я — {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} раб.
uk.R: Оскільки {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} любиш мене вірно, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знищиш моїх ворогів. Ти позбудешся всіх, хто проти мене, бо я — {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} раб.

decisions.choice: loyal love
decisions.reason: As in 5:8 (chesed).

decisions.choice: you will destroy: a confident prayer
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, the verbs can be read as requests or as the confidence that God will act. Either way the psalmist leaves his enemies to God.

decisions.choice: your servant: one who belongs to God and serves him
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, the psalmist calls himself God's servant ('eved), one who belongs to him and looks to him for protection (116:16).

decisions.choice: "me amas fielmente" (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns chesed into a verb, "you love me faithfully"; Spanish Readable follows it with "me amas fielmente" rather than the noun "amor fiel" used at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "Vì Ngài yêu thương tôi không hề thay đổi" (R), a verb for loyal love
alternatives: "tình thương không hề thay đổi của Ngài" as a noun
decisions.reason: Here the English Readable turns loyal love into a verb ("because you love me faithfully"); Readable follows that sense, with the words "không hề thay đổi" kept from the Readable term so the reader still hears the same love.

decisions.choice: tatsmit / ha'avadta "断ち…滅ぼしてくださる" (L), "絶ち…滅ぼしてくださる" (B), "滅ぼしてくださる…取り除いてくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: A confident prayer (m2), so the respect form てくださる; not "滅ぼされる", which reads passive. tsorerei "仇" (L, B), R as the English.
